notToBeConfusedWith.name: Fresh lime juice
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A cooked, sweetened, shelf-stable concentrate with a distinct cooked-lime flavour, not a substitute for the fresh juice the site also records.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: Coca-Cola GB's own product page states, per 100 ml: 91 kJ/21 kcal, 4.9 g sugar, water/lime juice from concentrate (5%)/sugar/citric acid/flavourings/preservative (sodium metabisulphite, hence the sulphites tag)/colours. A separate secondary listing (Difford's Guide) states 53 kcal per 100 ml for the same product with no sugar figure, which this record does not reconcile; the producer's own page is preferred per house sourcing order. Density has no measured liquid source and is taken from density-classes.json's 'juice-sweet' class (1.05 g/ml). acidPercent is left off: no titratable-acidity figure was found for this specific blend, unlike fresh lime juice.
